notes.title: 0.960 - General Updates
notes.content:
[b]News[/b]

Registered for Next Fest! June 9th.
We have about 3 weeks to get this demo ready!

Main purpose of this update is to test the new spawning mechanics and rebalanced enemy stats.

[b]Known Issues![/b]

• Pathfinding is a bit rubbish around some smaller items. This is being worked on.
• Some audio is missing.
• FPS can still drop when there are a lot of enemies on screen, it's tempting to call it a feature, "Kill as many as you can before your computer explodes", but instead I will continue to work on optimisations.

[b]Gameplay changes[/b]

• Enemies get knocked back from around player on level up
• Enemies "loop" round at a greater distance, that is the distance from the player at which they despawn / respawn, meaning a little more breathing room.
• Gear gun slightly nerfed

[b]Difficulty and Enemy Changes[/b]

• All enemy health increased by 20%
• Max enemies alive increased from 150 - 300
• MiddleManager now a slow, fodder/swarm enemy
• Supervisor is now a Tank enemy
• Spawn rate increased
• New grouping and group spawn system
• XP now drops with 90% chance instead of 100%

- Spawn orchestration:
• Minute based spawning of certain enemies
• Boss variants of swarm enemies
• Waves of groups
• Waves of boss variants
• Chance for 2 bosses

• Modified crowd behaviour

[b]Audio Changes[/b]

• Poop sounds switched
• Invulnerability pickup audio

[b]QoL Changes[/b]

• Player collisions refined
• Enemy collisions refined

[b]Visual Changes[/b]

• Healthbar artwork
• Player level up particle effects
• Made the blood sprays a little more gratuitous
• Removed Deathcry from dash kills.
• Debris size decreased

[b]Optimization Changes[/b]

• All blood and gore now pooled, performance improved.
• Wortar puddles "pooled" ehhh get it?
• Wortar targets pooled.
• Dash flicker implementation refined, reduced calls by 99%.


[b]Bugs Fixed[/b]

• Dashing flicker on respawn now stops correctly - no more crazy flashing enemies 
• Fixed NullRef on upgrade menu when maxed
• Fixed NullRef on Weapon Select at end game/restart
• Fixed weird Wortar behaviour - double targeting, sprite size randomness
• Fixed game resuming during level up, jackpot, end game. Thanks Chris!
• Fixed weird animations
• Chair launcher issues fixed:
• Sprite direction
• Detachment

notes.title: Optimisation & Controller Support Update
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45536778/a21690e028350266145b45f561b33ebd69e26cdc.png[/img][b]Changelog:[/b]

[b]Gameplay Changes:[/b]

•	Added a new Invulnerability Pickup.
•	Increased enemy move speeds for added challenge.
•	Explosive projectiles now explode on impact with the environment.
•	Mogul health has been increased.
•	Signals damage has been increased.
•	Spawn rate of enemies has been tweaked for better pacing.
•	Introduced New Enemy Shooter: Security guards are now armed but spawn less frequently.

[b]Audio Changes:[/b]

•	Fixed an issue where double audio played during weapon selection.

[b]Quality of Life Changes:[/b]

•	Spawn Groups now also incorporate the female anatomy in the spirit of gender equality.
•	Full controller support: The game is now fully playable with a controller, including live switching between controller and keyboard/mouse with corresponding icons.
•	Total Credits now display on the game over screen.
•	Notification on the game over screen indicating if an upgrade can be afforded.
•	Added video resolution and windowed options.
•	Brief invulnerability granted after levelling up.
•	Upgrade UI (from boss drops) can now be skipped with the spacebar.
•	Enemy pathfinding has been refined, still primitive but smoother.
•	Health gain on level-up now provides a full health boost.
•	Refined enemy collisions with each other for smoother swarming behaviour.

[b]Visual Changes:[/b]

•	XP Pickup size reduced by 25%, reducing visual clutter.
•	Taser damage area now more clearly defined.
•	Pickup range visualization added for better clarity.
•	Added hover effects on the upgrade UI button.
•	Death cries now follow the player for improved readability.
•	Added random title selector for credit panels.
•	Increased running animation speed on enemies.
•	Added/Updated lore and in-game text.
•	Updated loading and splash screens for better compatibility across device sizes, including ultrawide monitors.

[b]Optimization Changes:[/b]

•	Explosions are now pooled, improving performance when many explosions occur.
•	Enemies are now pooled, leading to huge performance gains.
•	Lowered lifetime of blood splats for performance optimization, making the game less brutal visually.
•	XP magnet functionality adjusted to reduce CPU load when many XP pickups are active.

[b]Bugs Fixed:[/b]

•	Fixed issue where arrows on the minimap wouldn’t disappear when the target was null.
•	Jackpot button scaling issue has been resolved.
•	Bosses and items no longer get stuck in impassable areas (such as "Production Holes" and Offices).
•	Credit panels no longer display "Not equipped".
•	Improved mechanics for unsticking enemies that get stuck in corners.

[b]Development Changes:[/b]

•	Added a green health overlay to the player instead of pickups.
•	Group spawns now use the enemy pool for better resource management.

[b]KNOWN ISSUES:[/b]

•	Animations on enemies can be a little funky on stun and sit.
•	Lots of XP on map – 300+ causes fps drops
•	Chair launcher animations on enemies can be funky
•        Tester button on Main Menu information out of date.

notes.title: 0.9.801 Update
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45536778/9af5bc0a91b0a5a83d4a5fcca774665c01158b3b.png[/img]

[b]Gameplay Changes[/b]

•	Pink pills: More obvious
•	Enemy Spawn Radius: "Circle spawn" around the player increased by 50%.
•	Magnet Functionality: 
o	Any XP appearing while magnet is active (10s) will also be collected.
o	Any XP that was active when pickup was first collected will still be grabbed after effect is finished 
(unlikely due to XP travel speed and map size).
•	Dash Buffs: 
o	Duration increased from 0.3s to 0.4s.
o	Cooldown increased from 1s to 1.35s.
o	Invulnerability time increased from 0.3s to 0.5s.
o	Speed increased from 0.2 to 0.25.
o	Dashing into an enemy that doesn’t die knocks them down/back.
•	Kill All: Now removes half of a Boss’s health, regardless of max health.
•	Enemy Balancing: 
o	Lowered all enemy health by up to 50%.
o	Increased Boss health by 400%.
________________________________________

[b]Audio Changes[/b]

•	Pill pickup, achievement, dash impact, and jackpot sounds are now assigned to an audio track and can be adjusted in options.
•	Mortar Select sound volume increased.

________________________________________

[b]QoL Changes[/b]

•	In an effort to make the game ‘woke’ enemies can now spawn in the shape of a nob and balls.
•	Tab Key under the map.
•	Default audio level set to 50%.
•	Minimap arrows added for regular crates, magnets, stun, and health pickups.
•	Arrows added to all pickups (except pills and credits); arrows visible behind objects.

________________________________________

[b]Visual Changes[/b]

•	Office Chair Sprite: New 6-directional sprite.
•	Upgrade UI Confirmation Button changed to a sign instead of a pill.
•	Crate Effects: All crates now have effects upon opening/destroying.
•	Bullet ImpactFX: Bullets now have environmental impact effects.
•	Jackpot: Now has colour and PIZZAZ.

________________________________________

[b]Optimization Changes[/b]

•	Magnet Optimization: 
o	Object pools now inherit from a base XP Pool class.
o	Single player reference instead of 900+ "find player" calls.
o	When a magnet is collected: ZERO "find player" calls instead of X = active XP pickups. Big win.

________________________________________

[b]Bugs Fixed[/b]

•	Fixed Kill All icon staying on the map after pickup.
•	Locked levels button text now consistent.
•	Pause menu fix: Closing the pause menu while options is open no longer causes options to stay open upon re-pausing.
•	Pause menu UI now correctly appears over the selected mood pop-up.
•	Floating black square removed from options menu.
•	Player collisions against chain-link fencing fixed.
•	Fixed enemies getting stuck running in place after slipping in water/poop or being knocked over.
•	Poop button in weapon select now fully clickable.
•	Priority Shipping Augment button in the shop now works.
•	XP bar visual bug fixed: No longer appears full when not leveling up (gameplay unaffected).
•	Shop refund system fixed: Now properly refunds and re-locks weapons and augments when refunded.
•	Shop scrolling fix: Now always opens scrolled to the top (pending further testing, as issue was inconsistent).
•	Jackpot UI fix: Text now appears only after spins are complete.
•	Audio/Visual options now properly save.
•	Re-roll system fixed: Now correctly counts and functions as intended.

________________________________________

[b]Development Changes[/b]

•	Pool base class implemented 
•	Base speed getter for enemies to address stuck enemy bugs.
•	Removed 99% of hardcoded strings: 
o	Some converted to ENUMS.
o	Some replaced with direct function calls for coroutines.
o	More efficient, easier development, possible performance boost.
•	Added tester info for known bugs and upcoming features.

notes.title: First Update!
notes.content:
[h1]Changelog[/h1]

[b]Gameplay Tweaks[/b]

Enemies now have 8% less health, so maybe you'll actually kill them this time.
Bullets now pass through fences—because apparently, wood and chain-link shouldn't stop bullets. Who knew?
Social links in the credits are now clickable.
Achievement tracking in the Codex no longer mysteriously vanishes. Turns out, keeping track of progress is useful.
Adjusted locked area lighting because immersion or whatever.
Pillars now cast slightly more shadows, so you can tell they exist. You're welcome.
The upgrade shop will now nag you with a notification chip if you can afford an upgrade.
Dynamic Spawning: Enemies will now adjust their spawn rates based on the chaos level. Good luck.
Shelving items now actually overlap correctly.
You can now spam spacebar to cycle menus faster when you die. Efficiency in failure.

[b]Development Stuff[/b]

Added Control Key support to button prefabs. Devs rejoice. Players? Probably don’t care.

[b]Bugs Squashed[/b]

Enemies can now properly enter locked areas.
Game over animation, sound, and blood FX are finally synced.
The Level Up menu is now properly layered above the mood title. Also, the mood title uses scaled time, making the first 20 seconds less of a panic attack.

Now go play. Or don't. Either way,[b] AWI is watching.[/b]
